instruction: Run one compliance reading contract probe for CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.2 by calling compliance_ask, whose receipt is what is scored. The first compliance tool call must be compliance_requirement, then use the available reading tools as needed. Return one JSON object with closure_complete (boolean), closure_unread (list), citations (list of objects each carrying resolved=true or false), unsupported_absence (integer count), first_tool (string), ground_truth_verdict (scored or honest-BLOCKED), and ground_truth_section_hits (list). Do not claim an absence unless the linked operator sections were read. End with: READING CONTRACT COMPLETE
